SELECT r.id AS usage_id, m.id AS medication_id, m.name AS medication_name, m.unit AS unit, r.total_quantity AS quantity, r.status AS status, r.used_at AS used_at, u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, r.cancelled_at AS cancelled_at, cu.name AS cancelled_by, r.cancel_reason AS cancel_reason FROM tb_usage_record r JOIN tb_medication m ON m.id = r.medication_id JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.id = r.cancelled_by
ORDER BY r.used_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.usage_id AS usage_id, a.lot_id AS lot_id, l.lot_number AS lot_number, a.allocated_quantity AS quantity FROM tb_usage_lot_allocation a JOIN tb_stock_lot l ON l.id = a.lot_id WHERE a.usage_id IN #{id} ORDER BY a.usage_id, a.id
